map.算法（Deurenberg）：体脂% = 1.2×BMI + 0.23×年龄 −: Algorithm (Deurenberg): body fat % = 1.2×BMI + 0.23×age − 10.8×(male 1 / female 0) − 5.4; BMI = weight ÷ height². All values must be >0. A rough estimate with an error of about ±3.5%.
map.公式法误差较大，仅作趋势参考；较准方法为皮褶厚度、生物电阻抗(BIA)、DXA（: The formula has a fairly large error and is only for trend reference; more accurate methods are skinfold thickness, bioelectrical impedance (BIA) and DXA (dual-energy X-ray). Gym-goers with a lot of muscle tend to have their body fat overestimated.
map.男女公式为何不同？: Why do the male and female formulas differ?
map.同 BMI 下男性基础脂肪低于女性，公式用 −10.8（男）/0（女）修正性别差: At the same BMI, men have less essential fat than women, so the formula corrects for sex with −10.8 (male) / 0 (female); healthy body fat for women is usually higher than for men.
